summary_zh: 本页为绘本《渔夫和金鱼》的封面，展示了书名、作者普希金及出版社信息，画面中渔夫指向一条从海浪中跃出的金鱼，背景为简洁的白色。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
在蔚蓝的大海边，有一座破烂的泥棚，渔夫和他的妻子就住在那里。
每天清晨，渔夫出海打鱼，他的妻子在家里纺纱织布。他们过着贫穷的生活。多亏渔夫打鱼的本领好，他们才没有饿过肚子。春去冬来，日子就这样一天天过去，他们的生活普通而又平静，没有任何变化。
page_text_en:
By the vast blue sea, there was a dilapidated mud hut, where the fisherman and his wife lived.
Every morning, the fisherman went out to sea to fish, while his wife spun yarn and wove cloth at home. They lived a poor life. Thanks to the fisherman's good fishing skills, they never went hungry. As spring passed and winter came, days went by one after another, and their life remained ordinary and peaceful, with no changes at all.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了渔夫和妻子在海边破烂泥棚中的平凡生活，文字介绍了他们每日劳作、生活贫困但安稳的日常。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
一天，渔夫照常出海去打鱼。他向海里撒下渔网，收网时却发现只网住了一条鱼。不过这是一条非常特别的鱼，它浑身金光闪闪，漂亮极了！更神奇的是，金鱼竟然开口说话了：“放了我吧，老爷爷，我会报答你的，你需要什么尽管说！”
渔夫从来没有见过会讲话的鱼，他对金鱼说：“鱼儿啊，我可不需要你报答！”
说完，渔夫就把金鱼放回了大海。金鱼摇了摇尾巴，消失在无边无际的大海里。
page_text_en:
One day, the fisherman went out to sea as usual to fish. He cast his net into the sea, and when he pulled it in, he found only one fish caught. But this was a very special fish—it was golden and shimmering, beautiful beyond words! Even more amazing, the golden fish actually spoke: "Let me go, old man, I will reward you. Just tell me what you need!"

The fisherman had never seen a talking fish before. He said to the fish, "Little fish, I don't need your reward!"

After saying that, the fisherman released the golden fish back into the sea. The fish wagged its tail and disappeared into the boundless ocean.
summary_zh: 渔夫出海捕鱼时捕到一条会说话的金鱼，金鱼请求他放自己回去并承诺报答，渔夫婉拒后将其放归大海。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫回家以后，发现家里的破木盆果然变成了新的，可是老太婆却更生气了，“木盆能值多少钱？快去，去找金鱼要座木房子！
渔夫只好又来到海边，再次呼唤金鱼。金鱼很快就游了过来。
“鱼儿鱼儿，我家老太婆吵着闹着要一座木房子。”渔夫难为情地说。
金鱼回答：“老爷爷，请放心，她已经有了木房子。”
page_text_en:
After the fisherman came home, he found that the old wooden basin had indeed become new, but his old wife was even angrier. "How much is a wooden basin worth? Go quickly and ask the golden fish for a wooden house!"

The fisherman had no choice but to return to the seaside and call out to the golden fish again. The golden fish swam over quickly.

"Little fish, little fish, my old wife is demanding a wooden house," the fisherman said, embarrassed.

The golden fish replied, "Grandfather, please don't worry—she already has a wooden house."
summary_zh: 渔夫回家发现妻子因木盆变新而更加不满，要求他向金鱼索要木房子；渔夫无奈再次呼唤金鱼，金鱼回应说妻子已拥有木房子。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh: 渔夫回到家，把金鱼的事说给妻子听。妻子指着他的鼻子骂道：“我们家的木盆都破得不成样子了，你怎么不找它要只木盆呢？”于是渔夫来到海边，呼唤金鱼。金鱼游过来了，“老爷爷，您有什么事吗？”“鱼儿鱼儿，我家老太婆不让我安宁，她想要一只新木盆。”金鱼轻快地摇摇身子，“老爷爷，请放心，她已经有了新木盆。”
page_text_en: The fisherman returned home and told his wife about the golden fish. His wife pointed at his nose and scolded, "Our wooden basin is broken beyond repair! Why don't you ask it for a new one?" So the fisherman went to the seaside and called out to the golden fish. The fish swam over. "Grandfather, is there anything you need?" "Little fish, little fish, my old wife won't let me rest; she wants a new wooden basin." The golden fish lightly shook its body. "Grandfather, please don't worry, she already has a new wooden basin."
summary_zh: 渔夫回家后向妻子讲述金鱼的事，妻子不满家中破旧木盆，要求他向金鱼索要新木盆；渔夫无奈再次呼唤金鱼，金鱼回应已满足其要求。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫回到家，他吓了一大跳。
泥棚不见了，展现在他眼前的是一座木房子。木房子又结实又漂亮，
比他们以往住的泥棚好多了。
老太婆一看到渔夫，就跳得老高，“你这老家伙，怎么就要了
座木房子！我不想住木房子，也不想当乡下的庄稼婆，我要住进大楼
房，做个贵妇人！”
page_text_en:
The fisherman returned home, and he jumped in surprise.
His mud hut was gone, replaced by a wooden house. The wooden house was sturdy and beautiful,
far better than the mud hut they used to live in.
As soon as the old woman saw the fisherman, she jumped up and down, "You old fellow, how come you only got
a wooden house! I don't want to live in a wooden house, nor do I want to be a country bumpkin. I want to live in a big
mansion and become a noblewoman!"
summary_zh: 渔夫回到家，发现泥棚已变成一座漂亮的木房子，但妻子看到后却不满，要求住进大楼房，做个贵妇人。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫没有办法，低着头又走向海边。平静的海面变得波涛汹涌。在渔夫的呼唤中，金鱼游了过来。
渔夫为难地说：“鱼儿鱼儿，真不好意思，老太婆的脾气发得更大了，这一回她要住大楼房，要做贵妇人！”
金鱼回答道：“老爷爷，别担心，她已经有了大楼房，也成了贵妇人！”
page_text_en:
The fisherman had no choice but to lower his head and walk back to the seaside. The calm sea became turbulent. In the fisherman's call, the golden fish swam over.
The fisherman said hesitantly, "Little fish, little fish, I'm really sorry, but my old wife's temper has gotten even worse. This time, she wants to live in a big house and become a lady!"
The golden fish replied, "Grandpa, don't worry. She already has a big house and has become a lady!"
summary_zh: 渔夫因妻子要求住大楼房而再次呼唤金鱼，金鱼回应已满足其愿望，画面右侧展示了变为漂亮大楼房的住所。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫往家里走去，他看见小木屋已经变成了高大的楼房。用大理石砌成的楼房在阳光下闪闪发光，别提有多气派了。
老太婆得意极了，她穿着名贵的衣服，脖子上戴着珍珠项链。仆人们勤劳地工作着，可是老太婆仍然用鞭子抽打他们。
看到渔夫回来了，老太婆对他大声呵斥，让他去干又脏又累的活。
没过几天，老太婆又不满足了，这一回，她要做自由自在的女皇！
page_text_en:
The fisherman walked home and saw that the little wooden house had become a tall, grand building. The marble building sparkled in the sunlight—how magnificent it looked!

The old woman was extremely proud. She wore expensive clothes and a pearl necklace around her neck. The servants worked hard, but the old woman still whipped them.

When the fisherman returned, the old woman shouted at him and ordered him to do dirty, tiring work.

After a few days, the old woman was still not satisfied. This time, she wanted to be a free and easy queen!
summary_zh: 渔夫回家发现小木屋已变成豪华楼房，妻子却仍不满足，继续苛待仆人并要求渔夫向金鱼索要成为女皇的权力。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫觉得现在的生活已经很好了，他不愿意再去找金鱼。于是，老太婆干脆让仆人把渔夫押到了海边。蔚蓝的海水翻腾起来，溅起的浪花足足有一人高。
渔夫不情愿地呼唤着金鱼，金鱼和往常一样向他游了过来。“鱼儿鱼儿，请你行行好，我家老太婆大吵大闹，她想要做自由自在的女皇！”“老爷爷，别担心，她已经当上女皇了。”
page_text_en:
The fisherman thought his current life was already good enough, and he didn't want to go look for the golden fish again. So, the old woman had her servants take the fisherman to the seaside. The azure sea surged, and the splashing waves were as high as a person.
The fisherman reluctantly called out to the golden fish, who swam toward him as usual. "Golden fish, golden fish, please do me a favor. My old wife is making a big fuss—she wants to be a free and easy empress!" "Grandfather, don't worry, she has already become empress."
summary_zh: 渔夫因妻子要求成为女皇而被仆人押到海边，他不情愿地呼唤金鱼，金鱼回应已满足其愿望，画面左侧展示妻子成为女皇后威严的场景，右侧描绘渔夫在海边呼唤金鱼的情景。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫跌跌撞撞地往回走。金鱼说的没错，楼房变成了宏伟的皇宫，外面还有威风凛凛的卫兵把守。老太婆已经是女皇啦，她喝的美酒、吃的糕点都是从国外运来的！
渔夫对老太婆说：“尊敬的女皇，现在你满意了吧！”老太婆瞧都不瞧他一眼，连声吩咐卫兵赶他走。卫兵奔了过来，抓住渔夫往外推，把他赶出了皇宫。
page_text_en:
The fisherman stumbled back. The goldfish was right—the house had become a magnificent palace, guarded by imposing soldiers. The old woman was now a queen, drinking fine wine and eating pastries imported from abroad!
The fisherman said to the old woman, "Your Majesty, are you satisfied now?" The old woman didn't even look at him, and immediately ordered the soldiers to drive him away. The soldiers rushed over, grabbed the fisherman, and pushed him out of the palace.
summary_zh: 渔夫回到皇宫，发现妻子已成为女皇，生活奢华，但妻子对他毫不理睬，反而命令卫兵将他赶出皇宫。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫只好在他的渔船里休息。人们嘲笑渔夫说：“看看这不知好歹的老渔夫，竟敢闯进皇宫，触怒至高无上的女皇，真是糊涂啊！”
渔夫仍然像以前一样打鱼，可他再也打不到一条鱼了。夜晚来临了，渔夫在船里又冷又饿，他往岸上一看，老太婆的皇宫灯火通明，还不停地传出欢声笑语。渔夫想，这样也好，老太婆终于满足了。
page_text_en:
The fisherman could only rest in his fishing boat. People mocked the fisherman, saying, 'Look at this foolish old fisherman, daring to enter the palace and anger the supreme empress—how foolish!' 
 The fisherman still fished as before, but he couldn't catch a single fish anymore. Night fell, and the fisherman was cold and hungry in his boat. He looked toward the shore and saw the old woman's palace brightly lit, with laughter echoing from within. The fisherman thought, 'This is fine; the old woman is finally satisfied.'
summary_zh: 渔夫因妻子成为女皇而被赶出皇宫，只能在渔船上休息，人们嘲笑他不知好歹；他再也打不到鱼，夜晚在船上饥寒交迫，却看到妻子的皇宫灯火通明、欢声笑语，他心想妻子终于满足了。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
可是老太婆并没有善罢甘休，没过几天，她就派大臣把渔夫抓进了皇宫。老太婆盛气凌人地命令渔夫：“滚到海边去，告诉金鱼，我不想做女皇了，我要生活在大海上，做海上的女霸王，还要让金鱼亲自来伺候我！”
渔夫听了，吓得浑身直哆嗦，可是卫兵们用锋利的斧头对准了他，他根本不敢顶嘴。渔夫被卫兵们押到了海边。
page_text_en:
But the old woman was not satisfied. After a few days, she sent her ministers to capture the fisherman and bring him to the palace. The old woman, in a domineering manner, ordered the fisherman: "Go to the seaside and tell the golden fish that I no longer want to be empress. I want to live on the sea, to be the queen of the sea, and I want the golden fish to serve me personally!"
Upon hearing this, the fisherman trembled with fear. However, the soldiers pointed their sharp axes at him, and he dared not speak back. The fisherman was dragged by the soldiers to the seaside.
summary_zh: 妻子成为女皇后仍不满足，命令渔夫去海边要求金鱼让她成为海上的女霸王并亲自伺候她；渔夫被卫兵押到海边，吓得不敢反抗。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
大海波涛汹涌，海浪恶狠狠地拍打在海边的岩石上。渔夫小声呼唤着金鱼。金鱼游了过来，它看着渔夫苍白的脸，疑惑地问：“老爷爷，你怎么啦？”
渔夫咬咬牙，对金鱼说：“唉，得寸进尺的老太婆还是不满足，她想做海上的女霸王，还要你亲自去伺候她。”
这一回，金鱼什么也没有说，只是默默地游向了远方。
page_text_en:
The sea was turbulent, and the waves crashed fiercely against the rocks by the shore. The fisherman called out softly to the golden fish. The fish swam over, looking at the fisherman's pale face, and asked curiously, "Grandpa, what's wrong?"

The fisherman gritted his teeth and said to the golden fish, "Sigh, that greedy old woman is still not satisfied. She wants to be the queen of the sea, and she wants you to serve her personally."

This time, the golden fish said nothing, and simply swam silently away into the distance.
summary_zh: 渔夫被妻子逼迫，再次来到海边呼唤金鱼，请求金鱼让妻子成为海上的女霸王并亲自伺候她。金鱼听完后沉默不语，默默游向远方，不再回应。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
渔夫等了很久，不管他怎么呼唤，金鱼也没有再次出现。渔夫守在海边，等啊等啊，一直等到天黑，又从天黑等到了拂晓。
蔚蓝的大海无比平静，太阳慢慢地从海平面升了起来，新的一天开始了。渔夫知道金鱼永远都不会再出现了，他只好拖着疲惫的身体向老太婆的皇宫走去。
page_text_en:
The fisherman waited for a long time, but no matter how he called, the golden fish did not appear again. He stayed by the seaside, waiting and waiting, until it got dark, and then from dark until dawn.

The vast blue sea was calm, and the sun slowly rose above the horizon, beginning a new day. The fisherman knew the golden fish would never appear again, so he could only drag his tired body toward the old woman's palace.
summary_zh: 渔夫在海边等待金鱼回应，但金鱼始终未出现，他最终拖着疲惫的身体走向妻子的皇宫。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
page_text_ocr_zh:
奇怪的是，渔夫发现卫兵不见了，金碧辉煌的皇宫也消失得无影无踪，取而代之的是他们原来的那座破泥棚。
而老太婆呢？她正穿着打满补丁的衣服，坐在地上纺纱。摆在她身旁的，还是那个快要散架的破木盆。
page_text_en:
Strangely, the fisherman found that the guards were gone, and the magnificent palace had vanished without a trace, replaced by their original dilapidated mud hut.
And what about the old woman? She was wearing clothes full of patches, sitting on the ground spinning thread. Beside her was still that old, nearly broken wooden basin.
summary_zh: 渔夫回到家中，发现皇宫和卫兵都消失了，取而代之的是他们原来的破泥棚，妻子也恢复了原来贫穷的生活状态。

title_en: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish
summary_zh: 画面中，渔夫站在沙滩上，手指向海浪中的一条金鱼，金鱼在浪花中游动，场景表现渔夫再次呼唤金鱼的瞬间。
